title: CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATING II
description: Fundamentals of estimating and bidding construction projects; plan reading, specification interpretation; quantity take-off; types of estimates; estimating and methods of construction for sitework, concrete, and carpentry; estimating subcontracts, estimating job overhead and home office overhead; estimating profit, and computer-aided estimating.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: CEM 341.
A minimum grade of C is required in CEM 341.
meeting_html: W 12pm-1:50pm in OWEN 241 - Owen Hall 241 (9/23 to 12/4)
